PUBLIC NOTICE
MINISTRY OF WORKS AND FAMILY ISLAND AFFAIRS
DEPARTMENT OF PHYSICAL PLANNING
The public is hereby notified a Site Plan Application (SPA/7/2025) on behalf of
Sampson Cay Bahamas Limited is presently being reviewed by the Department of
Physical Planning for presentation to the Town Planning Committee.
The applicant is proposing to develop a 131.3-acre portion of Sampson Cay, in the
Exumas, for a resort development. The applicants propose a resort, residential lots,
a marina, restaurants, a beach club and other amenities on the site.
A public hearing will be held on Thursday, 5th February, 2025 at 6:00 p.m., at
the Black Point Exuma All-age School, for all interested parties to discuss and
address planning issues related to the proposed resort development.
Preliminary plans for the proposed development are available for viewing at
the Department of Physical Planning, located in the Aventura Plaza on John F.
Kennedy Drive, as well as the Local Administrator’s Office on Exuma during
working hours.
